about: Hosts that refuse automated requests. Their links are still checked and printed; a failure on these hosts does not fail the check. Every entry needs a reason.

hosts.reason: Medium answers 403 to automated requests (bot protection); the articles open in a browser.
Medium-hosted blog; same 403 bot protection as medium.com.
SEC.gov answers 403 to automated requests that do not declare a contact email in the User-Agent (sec.gov/os/accessing-edgar-data); the PDF opens in a browser.
Crypto Briefing answers 403 to automated requests (bot protection); the article opens in a browser. Cited only as an unverified lead.
TechFlow answers 403 to automated requests (bot protection); the article opens in a browser. Cited only as an unverified lead.
